description: Work the list as a queue: takes the next To Do task (highest priority, then oldest by default) and starts it and its first step. Atomic: no 2 agents get the same task. Returns the task, steps, project notes and next call, or that To Do is empty.

agent.description: Label shown to the person: "<client> in <repo folder>", e.g. "Claude Code in api-server" ("Claude Code" outside a repo).

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Any case, or an id. Unknown names match nothing.

name: taskhold_next
title: Take the next task
